query: "Can I put the Robin's Call Mug in the dishwasher?"
response:
Hi there,

The Robin's Call Mug is earthenware, which means it's best kept out of the dishwasher. Because earthenware is fired at lower temperatures than stoneware or porcelain, it's slightly porous and can absorb water and detergents over time — this can weaken the piece and cause crazing or cracking. The hand-painted robin silhouette on your mug is delicate too, so it deserves a gentle touch.

Hand wash it in warm water with mild soap and dry it right away with a soft cloth. Avoid soaking it, and treat those painted details gently. With proper care, your Robin's Call Mug will develop a beautiful patina over time and keep that morning birdsong feeling alive in your hands for years to come.

Warmly,
Olivia Babu(image attached)
